name: clean_temp
description: Delete all files in %TEMP% and C:\Windows\Temp
task_prompt:
Write a Python script that safely deletes all files and sub-folders inside:
  1. os.environ.get('TEMP') or os.environ.get('TMP')
  2. C:\Windows\Temp
Skip locked / in-use files (catch PermissionError silently).
Track total files deleted and total MB freed.
Print a summary report: files deleted, folders deleted, MB freed.
